title: Design- Locked work orders show short notes, Declined locked (design's version)
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} are active at {Location-A} with the "Technician" role and Time Clock on.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST C682431 Ana and ZZAUTOTEST C682431 Ben.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has four work orders led by {Technician-A}: {Work-order-1} Invoiced, {Work-order-2} Declined, {Work-order-3} Imported, and {Work-order-4} Approved.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST C682431 Design Locks.
  • A second user, {User-B}, whose role has Work orders > View only, is signed in at {Location-A} in a second browser on the same starting screen.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST C682431 Viewer.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, the name of {Customer-A} in "Search", no filter chosen, "Assigned to me" off.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the "More actions" (…) menu on the card for {Work-order-1}.
  2. Drag the card for {Work-order-1} over {Technician-B}'s column and hold it there.
  3. Press Escape and let go.
  4. Drag the card for {Work-order-2} over {Technician-B}'s column and hold it there.
  5. Press Escape and let go.
  6. Drag the card for {Work-order-3} over {Technician-B}'s column and hold it there.
  7. Press Escape and let go.
  8. In the second browser, as {User-B}, drag the card for {Work-order-4} over {Technician-B}'s column and hold it there.
  9. Press Escape and let go.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the lead technician item is greyed out and reads "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned".
  • Step 2: a note on the card reads "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned".
  • Step 3: the card stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 4: a note reads "Declined · can’t be reassigned".
  • Step 5: the card stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 6: a note reads "Imported · review before assigning".
  • Step 7: the card stays in {Technician-A}'s column.
  • Step 8: a note reads "You don’t have permission to assign technicians".
  • Step 9: the card stays in {Technician-A}'s column.

This case checks the DESIGN's version, which differs from the PRD: Note on a locked work order's menu item and while dragging it: the design shows "Invoiced · can’t be reassigned" (and "Paid · can’t be reassigned"); the PRD says "The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.". Declined work orders: the design shows locked: "Declined · can’t be reassigned"; the PRD says "Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.". Imported work orders on the board: the design shows shown on the board, locked with "Imported · review before assigning"; the PRD says "Imported work orders open in List.". Note for a user who may not reassign, while dragging: the design shows "You don’t have permission to assign technicians"; the PRD says no wording given (users without create and edit cannot drag). It is held until Chris Ward rules on rows D06, D07, D08, D09 of the WO Board design-differences question sheet for Chris Ward (19 Oct 2026). Do not run it while it is held. If he rules for the design, it is released; if he rules for the PRD, it is removed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

What the PRD says instead:

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 66 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 19 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043

  • S4-N6: “The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Invoiced or Paid work order shows this tooltip: “The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.””
  • S4-N2: “Do not allow the lead technician to change in Invoiced or Paid status. An Invoiced or Paid work order can still be dragged to reorder it within its current technician (or within Unassigned), but it cannot be moved to another technician, to Unassigned, or out of Unassigned. Declined and Complete work orders can be moved freely, as today.”
  • S1-R13b: “In Board View and Tech View, "Imported" is greyed out in the Status filter with the tooltip "Imported work orders open in List."”
  • S4-N1: “Require Work Orders create and edit permission to drag work orders or access Reassign lead technician.”

Not yet checked against a build.

References from Design

Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026 (Work Orders.dc.html and its flows, driven 14 Oct 2026), read 19 Oct 2026: the source of this case's expected results.

  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Declined lock: “"Declined": "Declined \u00B7 can\u2019t be reassigned"”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Imported lock: “"Imported": "Imported \u00B7 review before assigning"”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, no-permission note: “const NO_PERMISSION = "You don\u2019t have permission to assign technicians";”
